_spec: The film of scenes — « option 3 », chosen by the owner on 2026-10-14 after the benchmark; it replaces the single 21-s flow of storyboard.json (docs/design/pro-app-preview.md, version 1). Cut from the takes recorded on 2026-10-14 (README.md « Version 2 — the takes of 2026-10-14 »). Nothing here is final until the owner signs it off. Takes are relative to --takes (build/app-store/pro/preview/v2/takes): one folder a take, its take.mov and the gestures.json reformatted from the recorder's gestures.jsonl. README.md « Version 2 — scenes » says what every value does.
_never_shown: sign-in; « Mon abonnement » or an offer; KYC (« Vérification »); a « Compte de démonstration — … » message; a system alert; a legible phone number; the « Prestations » price list as a scene. S6 never shows the salon's phone (it stays under the bottom bar: the scroll is 102 pt, the phone would need 138) — checked by eye on the frames, the tool cannot read it.
